Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Siya - 11 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Kavita - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Tanay: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Tanay (softly): "That's great!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Tanay (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Flower petals rain down on Tanay.]

Tanay: "That was fun!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Tanay: "Really?"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Kavita: "Yes, all right."

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Tanay: "Careful!"

[Tanay lights a bonfire.]

Kavita: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Siya and Kavita stand near him.]

Siya: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay puts on his school uniform.]

Kavita: "Siya, are you okay?"

[Tanay combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Siya: "What happened?"

[Tanay puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Tanay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Siya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Siya: "Hey, look at that!"

[Siya puts on red lipstick.]

Siya: "I'm ready!"

[Siya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Kavita: "What a nice place."

[Tanay throws the ball to Mother.]

Kavita: "Show me too!"

[Tanay catches the ball.]

Tanay (laughing): "What next?"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

Kavita: "Let's begin."

[Tanay hurts his knee.]

Tanay (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay helps Mother get up.]

Tanay: "How beautiful!"

[Tanay sneezes loudly.]

Kavita: "What a day to remember!"
